title: Fourier coefficients of a flipped parity
statement: For a nonnegative integer $k$, let $F$ be the Boolean function on $\\{-1,1\\}^{k+1}$ that agrees with the product of all $k+1$ coordinates except at the all-ones input, where its value is the negative of that product. For every subset $S$ of the coordinates, its real-valued Fourier coefficient at $S$ is $1-2^{-k}$ if $S$ is the full coordinate set, and is $-2^{-k}$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $k+1$ coordinates
